title: Test: evaluateTiming is eligible when the medication has no minimum interval, even with a prior dose
description: A medication with no configured minimum interval is always eligible regardless of how recently it was last given.
acceptance_criteria: @Test fun evaluateTiming_eligible_whenNoMinInterval() constructs a DoseLog with givenAtEpochMillis = 1_000_000L, calls DoseTimingCalculator.evaluateTiming(1_000_001L, thatDoseLog, null), and asserts the result is DoseTimingResult.Eligible
